payload.title: Edit any concept: name, description, kind, aliases
payload.description: Today `describeConcept` refuses generated concepts because runs could overwrite them; PPY-891a3f removes that reason. Edit in place on the concept page, records who and when, keeps a new SemanticNode version so edits can be seen and undone. Rename keeps the old name as an alias so links and searches still work. Also through the CLI. Requires PPY-891a3f. Screenshot review.
